charts.title: Wearables unit shipments worldwide from 2014 to 2028 (in millions)
charts.short: Total wearable device unit shipments worldwide 2014-2028
charts.description: In 2024, global shipments of hearables, watches, wrist-bands, and other wearables were forecast to reach around 560 million units. This is a 10.5 prcent percent year-over-year decrease compared to the previous year.

charts.title: Revenue of the digital fitness & well-being device market worldwide from 2019 to 2028, by segment (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Digital fitness & well-being device market revenue worldwide 2019-2028, by segment
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the revenue is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. This reflects the overall trend throughout the entire forecast period from 2019 to 2028. It is estimated that the indicator is continuously rising in all segments. In this regard, the Smartwatches segment achieves the highest value of 62.46 billion U.S. dollars in 2028.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness/activity tracking wristwear market worldwide from 2019 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the fitness/activity tracking wristwear industry worldwide 2019-2028
charts.description: The global revenue in the 'Smart bands' segment of the digital health market was forecast to continuously increase between 2023 and 2028 by in total 16.3 billion U.S. dollars (+83.5 percent). After the ninth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 35.84 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2028. Notably, the revenue of the 'Smart bands' segment of the digital health market was continuously increasing over the past years.

charts.title: Revenue growth of the fitness/activity tracking wristwear market worldwide from 2019 to 2028
charts.short: Revenue growth of fitness/activity tracking wristwear worldwide 2019-2028
charts.description: The global revenue change in the 'Smart bands' segment of the digital health market was forecast to continuously decrease between 2023 and 2028 by in total 8.6 percentage points. After the fifth consecutive decreasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 9.93 percent and therefore a new minimum in 2028.

Strava ranked second, with roughly 5.68 million U.S. dollars in combined revenues via Google Play and Apple App Store. Peloton accumulated around five million U.S. dollars in revenues, while Fitbit, the mobile app eponymous of popular wearable fitness and health tracking devices, generated 4.18 million U.S. dollars from its brand company, as well as [...]

charts.title: Leading health and fitness apps in the Google Play Store worldwide in June 2023, by revenue (in U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Leading Android health apps worldwide 2023, by revenue
charts.description: In June 2023, Fitbit was the top-grossing health and fitness app in the Google Play Store worldwide. The platform generated over six million U.S. dollars in revenues from Android users. MyFitnessPal was the second highest-grossing health and fitness app with roughly 2.55 million U.S. dollars in revenues from global Android users in the examined month. Hiking and trail maps app AllTrails ranked third, having generated around 1.5 million U.S. dollars in revenues in the last examined month.
charts.note: Worldwide; June 2023; IAP revenue in the Google Play Store
